# anyscale_role_binding_policy (Data Source)

~> **Beta.** Role bindings are enabled per organization by Anyscale while customers migrate; contact [support@anyscale.com](mailto:support@anyscale.com) to enable them. Breaking schema changes get a deprecation first and a changelog entry. See the [RBAC guide](../guides/rbac.md#role-bindings-beta).

Reads every direct role binding on one organization, cloud or project, in the shape `anyscale_role_binding_policy` takes. Bindings held on a parent scope are not included. Reading requires managing IAM on the scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Beta; Anyscale enables it per organization (contact
# support@anyscale.com). Reads every direct role binding on one scope;
# reading requires managing IAM on it.
variable "project_id" {
  description = "ID of an existing Anyscale project (prj_...)"
  type        = string
}

data "anyscale_role_binding_policy" "project" {
  project_id = var.project_id
}

output "project_role_ids" {
  description = "Roles held directly on the project"
  value       = keys(data.anyscale_role_binding_policy.project.roles)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cloud_id` (String) Read the bindings on this cloud. Specify exactly one of `organization_id`, `cloud_id` or `project_id`.
- `organization_id` (String) Read the bindings on the organization: the token's own, as returned by the `anyscale_organization` data source. Specify exactly one of `organization_id`, `cloud_id` or `project_id`.
- `project_id` (String) Read the bindings on this project. Specify exactly one of `organization_id`, `cloud_id` or `project_id`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<scope_type>/<scope_id>`, for example `project/prj_...`.
- `roles` (Attributes Map) Every direct binding on the scope, keyed by role ID (`rol_...`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))

<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Read-Only:

- `user_group_ids` (Set of String) User groups (`ug_...`) that hold the role. Null when none do.
- `user_ids` (Set of String) Users (`usr_...`) that hold the role. Null when none do.
